name: Old Stone Wall
description: Free 16k texture of a weathered stone wall: rough, uneven masonry with beige-brown stones, visible mortar, deep crevices and worn, eroded surfaces.
info: This is from the house I grew up in. Fun fact, that house is from the 19century and used to be a post house. Napoleon the third even spent a night in it! In the picture, you can see holes in the walls. Every years, swallows are nesting in some of them.
